channel.title: Projects on GP Singh
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on GP Singh

item.title: P5 — ATLAS (Autonomous Pentest Pipeline)
item.description: Autonomous HTB/CTF pentest agent: recon → enumeration → web → exploit → privesc → report. Tiered Claude with prompt caching. NSE vuln + hydra brute + SSH-based privesc. Human-in-the-loop checkpoints or full auto mode.

item.title: P4 — Mini-CRS (Cyber Reasoning System)
item.description: Autonomous vulnerability discovery pipeline: AFL++ fuzzing → ASan/GDB triage → LLM root cause analysis → patch generation → validation. Inspired by DARPA AIxCC.

item.title: P1 — SAST+DAST Triage Tool
item.description: Deduplicates Semgrep/Bandit/ZAP findings by CWE+location, scores risk 0-10, runs a local LLM to filter false positives, and exports SARIF 2.1.0 for GitHub Code Scanning.

item.title: P2 — Threat Model Generator
item.description: AI-assisted STRIDE threat modelling tool that generates executive-quality HTML reports with MITRE ATT&CK mapping, compliance flagging (GDPR/PCI-DSS), and on-prem LLM narratives from YAML, OpenAPI, Dockerfile, or docker-compose inputs.

item.title: P3 — AI Log Anomaly Detector
item.description: Parses Linux auth logs and journalctl JSON, detects 7 attack patterns mapped to MITRE ATT&CK with confidence scoring, enriches IPs via AbuseIPDB, and sends a local LLM threat assessment.

item.title: CTF Lab
item.description: HackTheBox and TryHackMe machine writeups with custom exploit scripts. Commit-on-root discipline: every rooted machine gets a writeup pushed to GitHub.

item.title: Memory Safety Lab
item.description: Hands-on C exploitation exercises — stack buffer overflows, heap corruption, use-after-free. GDB + pwndbg for dynamic analysis. Foundation for OSCP exploit development.

item.title: 75 Hard Tracker
item.description: Flask web app for daily 75 Hard check-ins, weight tracking, and GitHub commit streaks. Keeps the discipline visible.
